title: Mathematical artificial data for operator learning: reproducibility code
description: Code for Mathematical artificial data for operator learning, including MAD0/MAD1/MAD2 benchmarks, corrected response-balanced source data, input-RMS and raw-loss PINN comparisons, and earlier complex-geometry and nonlinear experiments. See reproducibility/r4/README.md for the final source-term protocols, included files, regeneration instructions and limitations.
